about: ✦ "AFTERDREAM is simply one of the best retro horror games that I have played in years if not decades – Well done Jesse Makkonen." - Tony Aksnes ✦ "In short, this is the best game yet from the developer and one to add to your list." - Vulgar…
Utilize the strange camera to navigate through the ghosts' mysterious residence. Find the purpose of your nocturnal visit in a vivid and dreamlike setting.

Navigate the obscure location populated by ghosts, and collect items to solve puzzles as you move further through the intriguing story. Look through the lens of your strange camera and photograph highlighted objects to interact with them.

▪ Side-scrolling 2D with unique art-style ▪ Interact with hidden objects through the lens of a strange camera ▪ Atmospheric music and sound design ▪ Delve into a lucid dream, bending reality and fiction ▪ Minimalist yet efficient… :)
summary: Get lost in a lucid dream, bending the lines between reality and fiction.
